The definition of this movement in art is characterized by visible brush strokes, ordinary subject matters, and an emphasis on light and its changing qualities. The first project is an impressionistic landscape using oil pastels and black mat board. Then we're using dye in spray bottles to make colorful geometric designs. Learn about color blending using special tools to create interesting effects in your art journal. And finally, blend colored glue to create a piece of art.

programme.desc: You've knit, purled and mock-cabled this far; keep the momentum going! In the third installment of the #OffOurKnitAlong, Tracie and Jodi demonstrate how to turn the corner on your Scania Shawl by working short rows.

programme.title: UPCYCLED Knitting: Turn Denim, Cotton & Plastic into Yarn!
programme.desc: Forget wool and alpaca fiber; upcycled socks and grocery bags are where it's at! Tune in to find out how to turn any tubular (and cuttable) material into knittable yarn.

programme.title: Provisional Cast-On, Cable Cast-On & Split Neckline
programme.desc: Since when do knitters use crochet hooks? Find out how to work the provisional cast-on, cable cast-on, and more during the first Novel-T check in!

programme.title: Patterns
programme.desc: Patterns are a design, motif or decoration, formed from regular repeated elements. They can also be naturally-occurring or a random arrangement of shapes, colors which have a regular or decorative effect. Patterns can be stripes, or lines, or alternating colors. The first project has a striped pattern of knots tied with plastic lacing. Next, make felt cookies with a polka dot pattern. Then add a chevron pattern to your art journal. Last, create a folding play mat with landscape patterns of a city scene around a lake.

programme.title: Lines
programme.desc: A line is an infinitely extending one-dimensional figure; one that has length but not width or thickness. In art lines are the basis that give form to a piece of art. They can be straight or curved, thick or thin, and raised or flat. Projects featuring lines: a modern art canvas with paint and masking tape; lines become three dimensional as we make a playhouse for dolls or action figures; continue with your art journal and use brightly colored pens and a special tool to make spirograph line drawings. Finally make an unbreakable stained glass plaque with foil.

programme.title: Twist It
programme.desc: Twist your way to great projects with an ombre bib style necklace using twisted jump rings, a soldered ring band from twisted wire with Kate Richbourg, and a wire crochet bead ball bracelet.

programme.title: Exotic Travels
programme.desc: Sometimes we get our sense of place right at home and other times our motivation comes from far off places and a sense of the exotic; something different from our every day. In this episode designers moved beyond their comfort zone. Up first Tracy Gonzales creates hamsa earrings featuring sari silk. Then Nealay Patel is back with earrings inspired by the exotic peacock. Finally, Tammy Honaman has tips for hiding fibers with an exotic and international flare when using a loom.

programme.title: A Day in the Life
programme.desc: The main reason we scrapbook is to capture those individual moments in time and keep them forever. Capture a moment in time in a scrapbook page, learn heat embossing with Kelly Purkey, and make a project life double page spread featuring a week in the life of Ali Edwards. A mix of ideas, supplies and designs - all in one Scrapbook Soup!

programme.title: Books
programme.desc: Books are not just for reading! Tool expert Joe Rotella cuts a niche in a book to create a planter. Craft metal book hinges with designer Mary Hettmansperger and Mou Saha makes vintage books into colorful art journals. Host Julie Fei Fan Balzer has a tip for creating a charming little book necklace.

programme.title: Wallflower Variable Star Quilt
programme.desc: It was only a matter of time before the Midnight Quilt Show tackled Janice Ryan's Wallflower Quilt! You bring the wine, Angela's got the Flying Geese covered.

programme.title: Cathedral Window Pillow
programme.desc:
The holidays are coming, but don't stress! We teamed up with Angela Walters, host of the Midnight Quilt Show, to create three DIY quilt projects that are super gift-able. In this episode, you'll learn how to make a cathedral window pillow, an adorable gift for someone in your life who you've deemed "quilt-worthy."
P.S. Don't miss Angela's tips for non-quilters on what to do (and what NOT to do!) when you receive a gift from a quilter...

programme.title: Bear Tracks
programme.desc: Quilting for charity can be one of the most fulfilling things you can do as a quilter.

programme.title: Cupid's Arrow
programme.desc: Angela is back for Season 5 of the Midnight Quilt Show! Today she is making the Arrows Quilt by Krystal Jakelwicz, and incorporating a little love note into her machine quilting.

programme.title: Quilted Tote Bag Challenge
programme.desc: Angela's been challenged by The Crafty Gemini to make a stash-busting tote bag. So she's stepping outside her comfort zone and up to the #MidnightStashChallenge!

programme.title: Craft Hacks
programme.desc: Time-saving quick tips to feed your crafting craving.

programme.title: National Sewing Circle presented by CraftsyTV
programme.desc: Learn to sew, step-by-step with National Sewing Circle experts on CraftsyTV.

programme.title: National Quilting Circle presented by CraftsyTV
programme.desc: Learn to quilt step by step with National Quilting Circle experts on CraftsyTV.

programme.title: Cook & Create
programme.desc: Welcome to CraftsyTV's Cook & Create, where delectable delights meet crafty creators.

programme.title: Artist's Academy presented by CraftsyTV
programme.desc: Welcome to Artists's Academy where we are dedicated to making you a better artist. We believe everyone has an artist within, waiting to be unleashed. Our mission is to be your ultimate resource for visual art education using tutorials covering everything from fundamental techniques to advanced concepts in painting and drawing.

programme.title: Workshop Math and Geometry Essentials
programme.desc: When it comes to woodworking, math and geometry go hand in hand. George shares his must-have insights around these subjects to help you get a better grasp on the mathematical skills you'll need for your woodworking projects. He'll explain how fractions, decimals, angles, and much more pertain to woodworking, and how to wrap your head around them when working on your next project.

programme.title: Minimalism & Improv
programme.desc: Less is often so much more. Minimalist quilt designer Nicole Neblett designs with negative space to achieve the modern aesthetic. Designer Luana Rubin shares inspirations from her world travels and lasting connections with quilters around the globe. Improv quilt artist Leslie Tucker Jenison cuts, pieces and sews curves without a ruler to create dynamic designs.

programme.title: Night Sky Quilt
programme.desc: Angela is back! In addition to quilting an amazing half-square triangle quilt by Monique Dillard, she's also announcing something HUGE!

programme.title: Pathfinder Quilt
programme.desc: Don't you love that feeling when you use up every bit of fabric for a quilt? Tune in as Angela blazes the path to a stash-neutral quilt that leaves no scrap behind.

programme.title: Carryalls
programme.desc: This year's hottest accessory for traveling is the carry all drawstring bag. First is Emily Thompson showing how to create a makeup bag. Then, in lesson four of the wrap dress, Angela Wolf creates a faux wrap variation in knit, plus techniques for the belt and neckline.

programme.title: More Quilting
programme.desc: There is a lot of cross over between sewing and quilting – techniques for one are often used in a different way in the alternate project. First Joanne Banko uses her serger for a quilt as you go technique that’s fast and easy. Next Emily Thompson shows paper piecing the easy way for beginners. We finish with Caroline Critchfield and a binding technique for any size quilt and great for other home dec projects too.

programme.title: Needle Tatting and Chainmaille
programme.desc: Lauren Andersen, The Chainmaille Lady has a new take on mixing other materials with chainmaille, including needle tatting and premade cuffs. Lauren also shares a tip for making your own jump rings. Katie makes a beaded cluster bracelet in her Beading Lesson.

programme.title: Bead It
programme.desc: Bead it, wear it and love it; designs to make and wear today. Katie creates a spiral bloom bracelet using irregular seed beads flowers and leaves, enjoy a peak at Elizabeth Ward's Czech glass collection, and last learn how to use large hole beads to make wire wrapped focal beads for a necklace with Candie Cooper.

programme.title: Episode 12: Turn on the Tools
programme.desc: Energize your creativity by adding power. Cheryl Boglioli gets into the groove with a cool stenciling tool. May Flaum adds texture with sewing machine stitches. Cheryl Boglioli shares a painting tip. Joe Rotella lights up lettering with twinkling lights.

programme.title: Episode 7: Tooling Around
programme.desc: Whatever the job -- the right tool makes all the difference. Host Julie Fei Fan Balzer starts with a study in layering; who knows what will happen as we keep adding layers. Then, Candie Cooper creates embellishments to jazz up our wardrobe. We finish up with Joe Rotella, our tool expert, using micro tools to make a home dec crate for every room.

programme.desc: Nareeman Dosa - Saudi-born, and of Sudanese heritage, - grew up in the Arab world experiencing the casual racism that most Black Arabs face. In Black and Arab, she visits Tunisia, the first Arab country to have made racial discrimination a criminal offence, embarking on a journey to explore whether the law can alter deep-rooted prejudice, as well as speaking to other Black Arabs for whom racism has been a sadly pervasive part of their existence.

programme.title: Sheltered
programme.desc: In the busy world of the animal shelter, the loving bond between humans and animals is strained by the endless stream of abandoned cats, dogs, and rabbits. Pets are life companions - but for some, they are dispensable. With care and training by the passionate employees and dedicated volunteers, the hopeful animals are rehabilitated. Not every story has a happy ending, but the team fights on - even for the biggest misfits of them all.

programme.title: A Man & His Trumpet: The Leroy Jones Story
programme.desc: Follow the fascinating life story of trumpeter Leroy Jones. From the projects of New Orleans, Jones goes on to lead the brass band revival, and eventually catches the ear of Harry Connick Jr., and becomes known worldwide.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: House-to-house combat is one of the most brutal and intense types of land warfare. Recent conflicts in Bosnia, Somalia and Iraq have reinforced the need for training in this specialized skill set. At urban warfare training facilities throughout the world, we learn first-hand what it takes to survive!

programme.title: Turning a Blind Eye
programme.desc: In October 2019 an unthinkable tragedy hit the peaceful village of Jura in Switzerland. Christophe Keller slit his wife Mélanie's throat before cutting his own. The crime shocked the whole country. What had happened between this couple, living a seemingly ordinary life with their three children? Each year, nearly 90,000 women are killed by their partner or ex-partner throughout the world. Could more have been done to save Mélanie?

programme.title: Alaska Long Hunters
programme.desc: A true life adventure set in 60's Alaska, Documenting a young pilots life who through it all, meets his creator God and finds life's true meaning. Based on the book "Last of the Long Hunters" by Mark Rose (2015) This story records the life of a young pilot flying in Alaska's Frontier Arctic. You'll experience the front seat thrills of bush planes and helicopters operating in the most dangerous conditions on Earth. Flying in minus 60 temperatures and horrific storms, airborne among the magnificent mountains, glaciers and rivers that only Alaska has to offer. Once you've read this volume you'll not be satisfied until you visit Alaska yourself. Includes true-life experiences of accidents, comradeship, humor, heartbreaks and life in Frontier Alaska, gone forever when dismantled into parks and native lands in the 1970's.

programme.title: The Time of Their Lives
programme.desc: The ultimate coming-of-age movie. With a combined age of almost 300, Hetty, Rose and Alison love to share their concerns on everything from terrorism and global warming to sex, death and the meaning of life. The Time of Their Lives reveals the everyday mystery of how very old people experience life and the intense challenges that old age brings. Like first-hand witnesses reporting back from the edge of their own mortality, Hetty, Rose and Alison tell us things which are never spoken of.

programme.title: An Italian Youth
programme.desc: Mathieu Volpe, film director invites us to follow Sokuro over a long period of time. Through a few key moments in the love story between Sokuro and Nassira, he offers another perspective on economic migration, which through this embodied representation takes on a more intimate quality. Regret, nostalgia and lack are the side effects of these reluctant exiles, done out of necessity rather than desire, that are too often kept in the shadows. By offering faces and bodies to a current topic, by embodying it and taking the time to explore its complexity, documentary cinema allows to deepen our reflection; Sokuro and Nassira’s contradictory yet profoundly human aspirations as well as their story is superimposed over the media narratives around the subject, enriching and humanising them.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Bullets, shrapnel, and IEDs, all are dangers for Infantry. Modern military forces have designed a new generation of armor to help protect soldiers from the dangers of battle – Infantry Fighting Vehicles. This fascinating episode examines the progress of technology since the Second World War that has led to some of the incredibly versatile and lethal weapon systems known as Infantry Fighting Vehicles.

programme.title: The River Between Us
programme.desc: A River Between Us tells the story of the oldest and most bitterly disputed water war in the West today. The film's primary focus is the struggle for justice on the Klamath River, where forty years of bad blood between the local farmers, ranchers, Native Tribes, members of the Tea Party, state politicians and federal government have created one of this country's worst environmental crises. Most importantly, as part of the largest restoration project in American history, A River Between Us provides the solution to ending this generations-old conflict: in order to save a river, you must first heal a people.

programme.title: A Gallery Without Walls
programme.desc: In a secluded spot at the eastern end of New Zealand's Waiheke Island lies Connells Bay where John and Jo Gow, passionate and well-known in art and sculpture circles have established the Connells Bay Sculpture Park where art and nature are united to create special spaces for site specific sculpture.

programme.title: Ambulance
programme.desc: When a talented young filmmaker tells the story of his country with compassion, beauty, and warmth in an honest, straight and raw first-person account of the war in Gaza in the summer of 2014. Mohamed Jabaly, a young man from the Gaza City, joins an ambulance crew as war approaches, looking for his place in a country under siege. While thousands of things are published on the recurring violence, the stories behind them remain hidden. Noth this one.

programme.title: The War You Don't See
programme.desc: The War You Don't See is a powerful and timely investigation into the media's role in war, tracing the history of 'embedded' ad independent reporting from the carnage of World War One to the destruction of Hiroshima, and from the invasion of Vietnam to the current war in Afghanistan and disaster in Iraq. As weapons and propaganda become even more sophisticated, the nature of war is developing into an 'electronic battlefield' in which journalists play a key role, and civilians are the victims. But who is the real enemy?

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Air-to-air combat is one the principle war fighting skills a new pilot must learn. At a massive international air exercise we join crews from several countries as they learn the basics of air combat and what it takes to survive. We also learn about the technology of modern fighter jets.

programme.title: Apollo 8 Christmas At The Moon
programme.desc: This one hour documentary profiles the first manned Mission to the Moon, and includes interviews with the astronauts and many of the NASA officials who were a part of this historic event.

programme.title: Meltdown in Dixie
programme.desc: In the wake of the 2015 Charleston Massacre, a battle erupts in Orangeburg, South Carolina between the Sons of Confederate Veterans and an ice cream shop owner forced to fly the Confederate flag in his parking lot. MELTDOWN IN DIXIE explores the broader role of Confederate symbolism in 21st century America and the lingering racial oppression which these symbols help maintain.

programme.title: Last House Standing
programme.desc: It is about the stories about people who lost everything in natural disasters. Every year people lost their homes and many rebuild the exact same way. Most people had no idea if their insurance will actually get them whole again after a major disaster. If they have to evacuate, and their house is destroyed, many of the things that were lost can never be replaced. When you watch The Last House Stanidng you will meet people who are living the nightmare, and it doesn't have to be this way.

programme.title: On The Inside Of a Military Dictatorship
programme.desc:
“On the Inside of a Military Dictatorship” takes its audience back to when the military made their master plan for a so-called disciplined democracy in Myanmar and wrote a very scripted role for their enemy no. 1; Aung San Suu Kyi. In a dramatic way, the film builds the character- and story set-up to take us anew into the crisis we know from the news – however, with a radically different perspective. The story is based on unique acces to the key players in this complicated reality, including Aung San Suu Kyi and previous President Thein Sein.
It’s the story of how power struggles unfold and how political enemies can end up being closer than the ones they claim to fight for: the people. The audience gets deeper and deeper into this complex world of power driven by peculiar characters and even astrology.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Airborne soldiers are known as force multipliers because of their unique capabilities. Dropped behind enemy lines they can secure bridges or conduct ambushes. We learn more about what it takes to be a paratrooper at two of the best airborne schools in the world.

programme.title: Blame Game
programme.desc: Blame Game explores the challenges but also the possible solutions - some very simple - that could reduce waste, take advantage of an impressive skill-set, alleviate poverty and help our environment.

programme.title: The Last Surviving Cheetah's
programme.desc: Centered around the Asiatic Cheetah, an endangered species, which was believed to have been extinct before 1996. 'The Last Surviving Cheetahs" us a retracing of the director's journey to discover the Asiatic cheetahs in remote regions of Iran, and features footage gathered over 20 years of documenting and recording this animal.

programme.title: Our Story - Tales of Intensive Care
programme.desc: This landmark documentary by Oscar-winning director Kevin Macdonald, tells the story of Covid-19 virus in Britain through the experiences of people immersed in its impact, both personally and professionally. Using testimony from consultants, doctors and nurses - as well as weaving in the experience of patients, this documentary paints a vivid portrait of the working lives of ICU staff and those they treat during a global pandemic which proves both challenging, life-changing and often tragic for those caught in it.

programme.desc: Blame Game explores the challenges but also the possible solutions - some very simple - that could reduce waste, take advantage of an impressive skill-set, alleviate poverty and help our environment.

programme.title: The Last Surviving Cheetah's
programme.desc: Centered around the Asiatic Cheetah, an endangered species, which was believed to have been extinct before 1996. 'The Last Surviving Cheetahs" us a retracing of the director's journey to discover the Asiatic cheetahs in remote regions of Iran, and features footage gathered over 20 years of documenting and recording this animal.

programme.title: Ambulance
programme.desc: When a talented young filmmaker tells the story of his country with compassion, beauty, and warmth in an honest, straight and raw first-person account of the war in Gaza in the summer of 2014. Mohamed Jabaly, a young man from the Gaza City, joins an ambulance crew as war approaches, looking for his place in a country under siege. While thousands of things are published on the recurring violence, the stories behind them remain hidden. Noth this one.

programme.title: Our Story - Tales of Intensive Care
programme.desc: This landmark documentary by Oscar-winning director Kevin Macdonald, tells the story of Covid-19 virus in Britain through the experiences of people immersed in its impact, both personally and professionally. Using testimony from consultants, doctors and nurses - as well as weaving in the experience of patients, this documentary paints a vivid portrait of the working lives of ICU staff and those they treat during a global pandemic which proves both challenging, life-changing and often tragic for those caught in it.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: In the field of honor there is one group that stands above the rest, combat medics. They are there to help aid the wounded soldier, even if it is under heavy fire. We travel to several medic schools and participate in their training exercises to learn what it takes to save lives and make a difference for their comrades.

programme.title: Undaunted, Chasing History at the Boston Marathon
programme.desc: "Undaunted: Chasing History at the Boston Marathon" is a film about the comeback of one unique runner, a 3-foot-9 physician assistant who has been mistaken for a runaway child while training. It's also about a city rallying against terror. Thousands of runners returned to compete, while a million spectators came back to cheer despite their fear. Many more around the world admired a city that wouldn't be intimidated by an attack that left hundreds wounded and three dead. "Undaunted" is also a film about every runner's fantasy: For the first half of the 2014 race, to the astonishment and sustained applause of thousands along the course, Juli led the pack.

programme.title: Jaffa: A Guide to Gentrification
programme.desc: Jaffa, once a major port in the Middle East and the sister city of Tel Aviv, “the most expensive city in the world” per The Economist, has grown into an international tourist center, a coveted destination and last but not least a true real estate gem.

programme.title: Idomeni
programme.desc: Idomeni is both a place suspended in time, and a film shaped by scenes from the parallel lives of adults and children in the camp. The children do not go to school but live in their own world and take care of each other, having little contact with their surroundings. The film catches their bubble and shows: they are tomorrow's Europe. It is a place where you are suspended in time. You cannot move forward and you cannot go back. You are confined. But it is not a prison, it is a refugee camp. Refugee camps are usually located far away from the rest of society and they become like worlds of their own. This is a film about life in the camps. The film does not explore the dramatic events of the journey but the seemingly still and slowed down moments in the camps.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Every soldier, sailor and airmen has to pass one hurdle before coming a member of the military – basic training. This episode examines the physical and psychological tests and training that occur in basic training. The training that takes civilians and molds them into the warriors of the future!

programme.title: War Peace
programme.desc: War/Peace documentary film is re-introducing the radical student activists from the late 60s. Ex-leaders of The Weather Underground movement Bill Ayers and Bernardine Dohrn. For decades the government and press have tried their best to silence them. This film will serve as an historical reminder of what happened the last time a group of young minds planned to take over an unpopular government in Washington.

programme.title: Lalgam
programme.desc: Documentary that denounces the damage caused by the use of land mines in Western Sahara and shows the lives of those affected.

programme.title: Breaking the Silence - Victims of Abuse
programme.desc: Breaking the Silence is a call to action that illuminates the voices of survivors of childhood abuse and sexual trauma. Through powerful interviews, it reveals the impact of systemic neglect-and the path to healing, recovery, and collective awareness.

programme.title: A Social Cure
programme.desc: The true story of the highly successful South African social media campaign to combat AIDS

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Combat requires that soldiers be tough, capable of strength and good cardio-vascular endurance. Combat fitness is the specialized training that is given to soldiers to help them survive. We learn why this is important and how this training is even adapted for civilians.

programme.title: Golden Age
programme.desc: Extravaganza and glamour lining up in an existential contest against isolation, slackening limbs and lethargy. With unique access behind the scences, the Palace in Miami is shown as a buzzing and luzurious senior living community, repeatedly voted "American's Number One". The seniors live in a world full of parties and entertainment, but the Palace is also a thrivin business.... Who said that old age has to be boring? Golden Age opens the doors to the Palace, a retirement home of the kind that you have never seen before, in Miami. Gildings, ostentatious chandeliers, marble floors; like a cross between a luxury hotel and an Americanised copy of Versailles, the place is presented by its developers as the most beautiful retirement home in the US. The residents here are pampered by an army of employees devoted to their every whim, in a oermanent party atmosphere. This abundance of luxury, extravagance and entertainment is nonetheless not enough to remove the anxieties of those who live there. Nor can it hide the intention of the investors for whome old age is above all source of income and a growing market. Golden Age takes us on a journey into this baroque universe which tries to suppress the fear of death through dollars, questioning, in a dizzying visual whirlwind, our relationship to old age in its most universal aspect.

programme.title: Slow Fashion
programme.desc: Slow Fashion is a documentary that explores cultural appropriation of indigenous designs in Mexico by an international fashion designer and the way weavers and block printers in Laos and India are working with new sustainable designers, whose principals and practices are based on equality, not hierarchy. A major fashion designer from Paris has been appropriating traditional designs in the community of Tlahuitoltepec in the highlands of Oaxaca, Mexico. In response to this and other instances of global appropriation, Mexico's Ministry of Culture has asked global fashion brands for “a public explanation on what basis it could privatize collective property". Can credit and compensation be given to indigenous communities where the designs come from? Given the vast economic disparity between local communities of origin and the global companies, who are appropriating their designs; it becomes a matter of not only collective property rights, but also human and cultural rights. In Laos, craftmanship and the value of culture is examined by Nanci Takayama, professor/sustainable fashion activist. Working with communities of Laotian weavers, she raises the subject of empowerment of women artisans and weavers and explores alternative socially conscious ways of working with them in collaboration. She focuses

programme.title: I'm In Love With My Car
programme.desc: A colorful, sparkling history of The Car and us, in it. Hearing, smell, touch, sight, taste, that is to say all of the human biological nature, has apparently changed since we started driving. More than any other object, cars are anthropologically modified human beings, changed our world's perception and our way of engaging with it. With our unconditional love for cars at a turning point, will it survive?

programme.title: Women Behind The Wheel
programme.desc:
Two women. One epic journey. Countless stories that deserve to be heard. Cat and Hannah undertake a road trip across Central Asia on a mission to uncover women's stories in a region miles from their own. But along the journey, they're forced to challenge the assumptions they set out with.
Writers

programme.desc: Rangers are an elite light infantry whose sole purpose is to seek out and destroy the enemy. Each year, the US Army Ranger School holds a competition. A competition to find the best Ranger team in the army. Considered by many to be the ultimate Army Olympics, this intense 3 day event test the best soldiers in the world, to see who is the ultimate warrior

programme.title: The Illusion of Abundance
programme.desc: Three women share a common goal: Carolina, Bertha and Maxima are leading today's fight against modern conquistadors. Whereas governments and corporations, trapped in a global race towards unlimited growth, need to get the cheapest raw materials, these three women tell us a story of tireless courage: how to keep fighting to protect nature when your life is at risk?

programme.title: State of Rodeo
programme.desc: State of Rodeo follows a diverse group of characters who participate in the sport of rodeo and explores the heritage of the cattle industry within the state of Florida and it's influence on western culture from the time of Ponce De Leon's first settlement to present day cowboys and cowgirls. Rodeo still fascinates to this day, the heritage of this sport's tradition is one of the founding industries of our nation and most people don't know that Florida played an integral role in this history.

programme.title: The Song That Calls You Home
programme.desc: Filmmakers Vanni Mangoni and Luis Robledo explore the practices of Amazonian folk healers or medicine men who use herbs, hallucinogenic plants, magic, and spiritualism to treat illnesses.

programme.title: Women Behind The Wheel
programme.desc:
Two women. One epic journey. Countless stories that deserve to be heard. Cat and Hannah undertake a road trip across Central Asia on a mission to uncover women's stories in a region miles from their own. But along the journey, they're forced to challenge the assumptions they set out with.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Bullets, shrapnel, and IEDs, all are dangers for Infantry. Modern military forces have designed a new generation of armor to help protect soldiers from the dangers of battle – Infantry Fighting Vehicles. This fascinating episode examines the progress of technology since the Second World War that has led to some of the incredibly versatile and lethal weapon systems known as Infantry Fighting Vehicles.

programme.title: The River Between Us
programme.desc: A River Between Us tells the story of the oldest and most bitterly disputed water war in the West today. The film's primary focus is the struggle for justice on the Klamath River, where forty years of bad blood between the local farmers, ranchers, Native Tribes, members of the Tea Party, state politicians and federal government have created one of this country's worst environmental crises. Most importantly, as part of the largest restoration project in American history, A River Between Us provides the solution to ending this generations-old conflict: in order to save a river, you must first heal a people.

programme.title: A Gallery Without Walls
programme.desc: In a secluded spot at the eastern end of New Zealand's Waiheke Island lies Connells Bay where John and Jo Gow, passionate and well-known in art and sculpture circles have established the Connells Bay Sculpture Park where art and nature are united to create special spaces for site specific sculpture.

programme.title: Ambulance
programme.desc: When a talented young filmmaker tells the story of his country with compassion, beauty, and warmth in an honest, straight and raw first-person account of the war in Gaza in the summer of 2014. Mohamed Jabaly, a young man from the Gaza City, joins an ambulance crew as war approaches, looking for his place in a country under siege. While thousands of things are published on the recurring violence, the stories behind them remain hidden. Noth this one.

programme.title: The War You Don't See
programme.desc: The War You Don't See is a powerful and timely investigation into the media's role in war, tracing the history of 'embedded' ad independent reporting from the carnage of World War One to the destruction of Hiroshima, and from the invasion of Vietnam to the current war in Afghanistan and disaster in Iraq. As weapons and propaganda become even more sophisticated, the nature of war is developing into an 'electronic battlefield' in which journalists play a key role, and civilians are the victims. But who is the real enemy?

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Air-to-air combat is one the principle war fighting skills a new pilot must learn. At a massive international air exercise we join crews from several countries as they learn the basics of air combat and what it takes to survive. We also learn about the technology of modern fighter jets.

programme.title: Apollo 8 Christmas At The Moon
programme.desc: This one hour documentary profiles the first manned Mission to the Moon, and includes interviews with the astronauts and many of the NASA officials who were a part of this historic event.

programme.title: Meltdown in Dixie
programme.desc: In the wake of the 2015 Charleston Massacre, a battle erupts in Orangeburg, South Carolina between the Sons of Confederate Veterans and an ice cream shop owner forced to fly the Confederate flag in his parking lot. MELTDOWN IN DIXIE explores the broader role of Confederate symbolism in 21st century America and the lingering racial oppression which these symbols help maintain.

programme.title: Last House Standing
programme.desc: It is about the stories about people who lost everything in natural disasters. Every year people lost their homes and many rebuild the exact same way. Most people had no idea if their insurance will actually get them whole again after a major disaster. If they have to evacuate, and their house is destroyed, many of the things that were lost can never be replaced. When you watch The Last House Stanidng you will meet people who are living the nightmare, and it doesn't have to be this way.

programme.title: On The Inside Of a Military Dictatorship
programme.desc:
“On the Inside of a Military Dictatorship” takes its audience back to when the military made their master plan for a so-called disciplined democracy in Myanmar and wrote a very scripted role for their enemy no. 1; Aung San Suu Kyi. In a dramatic way, the film builds the character- and story set-up to take us anew into the crisis we know from the news – however, with a radically different perspective. The story is based on unique acces to the key players in this complicated reality, including Aung San Suu Kyi and previous President Thein Sein.
It’s the story of how power struggles unfold and how political enemies can end up being closer than the ones they claim to fight for: the people. The audience gets deeper and deeper into this complex world of power driven by peculiar characters and even astrology.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: The suicide of a woman shocked an entire village. It jolted an entire province, and word of her death even reached the imperial court. Upon hearing of the reasons behind this woman’s untimely death, the emperor decreed a magnificent arch be built in her memory, earning her family, her village and her province an honor of the highest degree. These beautiful arches, which dot China’s scenery, are the culmination of a culture founded on the remembrance of those who achieved a higher moral status than the rest of society, those who were chaste and remained pure, even in their deaths. Discover China passes on the story of Memorial Arches.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: At the turn of the century, a Child-Emperor ascended to the throne of the Chinese Qing Dynasty. Emperor Pu-Yi’s Reign was short lived and mired with treason, corruption and external influences. After abdicating his throne, Pu Yi knew his days in the imperial palace were numbered. Questions of his survival as a commoner began to trouble his mind. Upon looking at the wealth of priceless artifacts collected over 500 years of imperial reign, Pu Yi began plotting ways to smuggle these riches out. However, Pu Yi was not alone. Discover China brings you the story of how the precious treasures of the Imperial City disappeared from the capital palace, and where some reside today.

programme.title: Essence Of India
programme.desc:
Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye. She packs her bags and sets off.
New York’s signature street food is the hot dog. In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years. Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat.

programme.title: Essence Of India
programme.desc:
Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye. She packs her bags and sets off.
New York’s signature street food is the hot dog. In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years. Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat.

programme.title: Essence Of India
programme.desc:
The whole world loves a good curry, and living in New York, Samira loves to make curries, Indian, South East Asian and the Western stew, but she heads back to India where she learns how to make some of India’s finest curries.
Here is the story of ultimate deliciousness -- the tale of the curry. The desire to perfect her skills, sets her off on a curry trail, seeking out the best chefs in Delhi and getting them to spill their secrets.
This episode travels through the kitchens of master chefs, who created the king of all curries, The Butter Chicken, reintroduces the authentic korma, a recipe that has been tweaked across the globe and tells the story of the Raja Mirch, the hottest pepper in the world.

programme.title: Destination
programme.desc: Doused in heritage with old hamlets, drowsy villages and towns studding its lush green hills, Southern France’s Occitania region only officially come into being in 2016 with the pairing of Languedoc-Roussillon and the Midi-Pyrenees. The two historically Occitan regions are blessed with colour, tranquility, and a wealth of UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Food and drink are still approached with reverence in the region, and a whistle stop tour around four different departments of the Midi Pyrenees; Tarn, Gers, Tarn-et-Garonne and Haute Garonne gives you plenty of opportunity to experience some of its best gastronomy, as Katy Dartford discovers.

programme.title: Essence Of India
programme.desc:
Samira is all excited for the Tandoori Party.
The world loves to BBQ and India has some of the oldest forms – Tandoori cooking. Samira takes a fresh approach to Tandoori cuisine and the grill that goes back thousands of years.
The Episode starts off with a visit to a Street Tandoori hub that makes Kababs that have a cult following of their own. Samira ends up taking over grill, learns the art of Tandoori breads and how can any Tandoori feast be complete without the Pièce de résistance, The Tandoori Chicken and a Party!

programme.desc:

programme.title: Essence Of India
programme.desc:
Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye. She packs her bags and sets off.
New York’s signature street food is the hot dog. In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years. Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat.

Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E08 - Nuclear Industrial
programme.desc: Cuando los seres humanos son un grave peligro para sí mismos ... Horas desesperadas analiza catástrofes nucleares e industriales como el desastre de la central nuclear de Fukushima en Japón, el de la central nuclear de Chernóbil en Ucrania, el vertido de petróleo en aguas profundas del Golfo de México, el del Savar Plaza en Bangladesh y el del gas de Bhopal en la India. Cuando se produce una catástrofe en una central nuclear, el desastre resultante puede ser, literalmente, fuera de escala y durar décadas.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E09 - Disaster at Sea
programme.desc: La navegación es un negocio peligroso, de hecho...... Las horas desesperadas repasa las principales catástrofes ocurridas en alta mar, como el desastre del transbordador Sewol en Corea del Sur, el Ferry Estonia en el mar Báltico, el hundimiento del Titanic, el Exxon Valdez en Prince William Sound Alaska, el Express Samina en Portes Islets, los ataques piratas al Maersk Alabama y al Seabourn Spirit, y el Costa Concordia en el mar Mediterráneo.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E10 - Disaster in the Air
programme.desc: Where the black box is the only story teller...... Los accidentes aéreos son las peores pesadillas de la mayoría de la gente. Horas desesperadas repasa las principales catástrofes de la historia de la aviación, como los vuelos MH17 y MH370 de Malaysia Airlines, el vuelo 447 de Air France, el vuelo 9525 de Germanwings, el desastre del aeropuerto de Tenerife, las catástrofes de los transbordadores espaciales Challenger y Columbia, el accidente del C-130 de la Fuerza Aérea Indonesia en Sumatra en 2015, el accidente del Antonov An-124 de Irkutsk en 1997 y el accidente del vuelo 4590 del Concorde.
programme.sub-title: Desperate Hours - S01:E10 - Disaster in the Air

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E11 - Road and Rail Disasters
programme.desc: Abróchese el cinturón y manténgase alerta...... Horas desesperadas analiza los accidentes de tráfico y ferroviarios, entre ellos el accidente ferroviario español de Santiago de Compostela, un accidente de carretera en Pakistán, el accidente de un camión petrolero en Nigeria en el que murieron 96 personas, el accidente ferroviario del Queen of the Sea en Sri Lanka, los accidentes provocados por la niebla en Italia y el Reino Unido, un accidente de cien vehículos en la autopista A1 en Austria, un accidente de carretera en México y un accidente de Amtrak en Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E12 - Environmental Disaster
programme.desc: Más vale prevenir que curar...... Horas desesperadas analiza el Protocolo de Kioto y el peligro de la subida del nivel del mar. El programa examina las causas de las catástrofes medioambientales, como los vertederos, la gran mancha de basura del Pacífico, los vertidos de petróleo, la contaminación atmosférica y la destrucción de la selva tropical, así como los efectos destructivos de las catástrofes medioambientales, como el agotamiento de la capa de ozono y el aumento de las temperaturas en el Ártico.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E08 - Nuclear Industrial
programme.desc: Cuando los seres humanos son un grave peligro para sí mismos ... Horas desesperadas analiza catástrofes nucleares e industriales como el desastre de la central nuclear de Fukushima en Japón, el de la central nuclear de Chernóbil en Ucrania, el vertido de petróleo en aguas profundas del Golfo de México, el del Savar Plaza en Bangladesh y el del gas de Bhopal en la India. Cuando se produce una catástrofe en una central nuclear, el desastre resultante puede ser, literalmente, fuera de escala y durar décadas.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E09 - Disaster at Sea
programme.desc: La navegación es un negocio peligroso, de hecho...... Las horas desesperadas repasa las principales catástrofes ocurridas en alta mar, como el desastre del transbordador Sewol en Corea del Sur, el Ferry Estonia en el mar Báltico, el hundimiento del Titanic, el Exxon Valdez en Prince William Sound Alaska, el Express Samina en Portes Islets, los ataques piratas al Maersk Alabama y al Seabourn Spirit, y el Costa Concordia en el mar Mediterráneo.
programme.sub-title: Desperate Hours - S01:E09 - Disaster at Sea

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E10 - Disaster in the Air
programme.desc: Where the black box is the only story teller...... Los accidentes aéreos son las peores pesadillas de la mayoría de la gente. Horas desesperadas repasa las principales catástrofes de la historia de la aviación, como los vuelos MH17 y MH370 de Malaysia Airlines, el vuelo 447 de Air France, el vuelo 9525 de Germanwings, el desastre del aeropuerto de Tenerife, las catástrofes de los transbordadores espaciales Challenger y Columbia, el accidente del C-130 de la Fuerza Aérea Indonesia en Sumatra en 2015, el accidente del Antonov An-124 de Irkutsk en 1997 y el accidente del vuelo 4590 del Concorde.
programme.sub-title: Desperate Hours - S01:E10 - Disaster in the Air

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E06 - The Zambezi River Mystery
programme.desc: Carter's W.A.R. (Wild Animal Response) es la historia jamás contada de la búsqueda de un hombre para salvar su tierra natal, el continente más salvaje y peligroso del mundo, África. Desde cazadores furtivos fuertemente armados que masacran elefantes por sus colmillos hasta la matanza de rinocerontes por sus cuernos, el recurso más preciado de África está en peligro. ¿Puede un hombre descubrir la verdad y cambiar las cosas? Vea cómo Ivan Carter, detective de la fauna salvaje y cazador profesional, le lleva al interior del África real, a la primera línea de las guerras que se libran contra su fauna salvaje.
programme.sub-title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E06 - The Zambezi River Mystery

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S01:E01 - Meet Island Air
programme.desc: Miles de aventureros acuden a la isla de Kodiak para experimentar la naturaleza salvaje de Alaska a través de expediciones de caza, pesca y observación de la fauna, y Island Air Service hace realidad esas aventuras únicas en la vida. Volar con niebla, lluvia, nieve o aguanieve y trasladar a los aventureros, los lugareños, los suministros y los materiales a los rincones más remotos de la isla, todo es cuestión de un día para un piloto de monte de Kodiak y el personal y la tripulación de Island Air.

programme.sub-title: The Trail - S01:E06 - On the Move

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S01:E05 - Ron Smith Story
programme.desc: La historia real del encuentro de Ron Smith con un intrépido ciervo que les atacó a él y a su sobrino, Arik, mientras estaban pescando.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S01:E05 - Ron Smith Story

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S01:E06 - Jackson Jordan
programme.desc: Este episodio presenta a Jackson Jordon y su estrecha escapada de la muerte en los bosques de Georgia tras el ataque de una manada de coyotes cuando sólo tenía 16 años.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S01:E06 - Jackson Jordan

programme.desc: Manny se embarca en una aventura de caza de jabalíes en una pequeña isla en medio de un lago de Florida.
programme.sub-title: Savage Wild - S05:E02 - The Island Boar

programme.title: Savage Wild - S05:E03 - Wild Boar the Hard Way
programme.desc: Es otro día en los bosques de Florida con God's Country Outfitters cazando feroces jabalíes.

programme.sub-title: Savage Wild - S05:E04 - Handcatching Fish in the Dark

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E07 - Wild Australia
programme.desc: Más del 80% de las plantas, mamíferos, reptiles y ranas de Australia son exclusivos de este país y no se encuentran en ningún otro lugar del mundo. Los dingos salvajes, los juguetones canguros, los koalas de aspecto mimoso y los ornitorrincos juguetones son algunos de los animales salvajes más emblemáticos de Australia.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E08 - Masters of the Sky
programme.desc: Son muchas las palabras que describen las múltiples formas en que vuelan las aves: los pelícanos y los cernícalos remontan el vuelo, pero los búhos vuelan en silencio. Los loros vuelan en bandada, los buitres en enjambre y las águilas en picado. Los ojos precisos como radares escanean el suelo y las plumas ranuradas ajustan las trayectorias de vuelo cuando los halcones atacan. Pero, ¿cuál es el verdadero amo del cielo?
programme.sub-title: Wild Ones - S01:E08 - Masters of the Sky

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E09 - Disguised
programme.desc: Ahora me ves... ahora no. Una mirada a los maestros del disfraz. Desde lagartos ocultos y arañas invisibles hasta gatos camuflados y calamares resplandecientes.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E10 - Micro Predators
programme.desc: Pueden ser pequeños, pero no se deje engañar: los microdepredadores pueden ser mortales. Desde la impresionante araña Portia, asesina en serie, hasta los cientos de especies de hormigas y el pez arquero, con su preciso disparo de gotas de agua para asegurar su presa, Wild Ones mira a través del microscopio para descubrir su verdadera letalidad.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E08 - Naturally Raw
programme.desc: Este episodio comienza en Costa Rica, en una increíble selva tropical. Aquí se elabora un delicioso chocolate con granos de cacao. La madre naturaleza se muestra en todo su esplendor, con cientos de especies de plantas y animales. Y luego a Kenia, donde los monos verdes serán nuestros guías turísticos en la Ciudad Perdida de Gedi, además de observar más de cerca la vida salvaje que vive muy cerca de las bulliciosas calles de Nairobi.
programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E08 - Naturally Raw

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E09 - Naturally Invigorating
programme.desc: Islandia: hogar de lagos volcánicos y aguas termales y vistas monocromáticas. Y luego a Laos, en el Sudeste Asiático, con sus exuberantes selvas, cuevas subterráneas y búfalos de agua a lo largo del río Mekong.
programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E09 - Naturally Invigorating

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E10 - Naturally Potent
programme.desc: Explore las montañas vírgenes de Laponia y siga hasta los inmaculados Alpes suizos. Como contraste, viajaremos a la provincia francesa de Champaña, cuna de los mejores vinos del mundo. Por último, Gibraltar atrae con su larga historia y sus extrañas y misteriosas cuevas.
programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E10 - Naturally Potent

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E11 - Naturally Different
programme.desc: Las islas Shetland: hogar de 20.000 seres humanos, un millón de aves y el caballo más pequeño del mundo. A continuación, a una zona conocida por los lugareños como el Centro del Mundo, en la provincia sudoriental de Kazajstán. Desde allí iremos a las Montañas Amarillas, en China Central, a menudo llamadas La Venecia de China.
programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E11 - Naturally Different

programme.desc: Keefer Brothers分享了Dropped的幕後創作過程。

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E13 - Desperate World
programme.desc: Horas desesperadas examina algunas de las peores catástrofes del mundo. Analiza la erupción del Eyjafjallajökull en Islandia, los terremotos de Nepal. epidemias como el ébola y el SARS, el incendio de la Zona de Nuevo Desarrollo de Binhai en China, el huracán Sandy en Nueva York, el tsunami del Océano Índico en el sudeste asiático, un destructivo sumidero en Bosnia, el desastre de la central nuclear de Fukushima, la catástrofe del gas de Bhopal, el accidente del Exxon Valdez en Alaska, y accidentes de tráfico y aéreos.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E01 - Lost!
programme.desc: Nick and Laura subject themselves to intense survival training with the Survival Training School of California deep in the mountains.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E02 - Sniper Science
programme.desc: Nick y Laura exploran la variedad de habilidades que utilizan los francotiradores militares: puntería, tiro a larga distancia, detección, acecho, camuflaje, infiltración, reconocimiento especial y adquisición de objetivos.

programme.title: Survival Science - - S01:E03 - Surviving a Bear Attack
programme.desc: Nick y Laura ponen a prueba la potencia y velocidad de los osos pardos utilizando herramientas de acróbatas de Hollywood para experimentar un ataque. Además: un intento de recrear el disparo de una flecha que salvó a un hombre del ataque de un oso.
programme.sub-title: Survival Science - - S01:E03 - Surviving a Bear Attack

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E04 - Surviving a Mountain Lion Attack
programme.desc: Laura y Nick desmenuzan los comportamientos, la fuerza, la vista y la velocidad de los pumas mediante experimentos y exploran técnicas para hacer frente a estos depredadores ápice.
programme.sub-title: Survival Science - S01:E04 - Surviving a Mountain Lion Attack

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E06 - Crushed by a Boulder Part 2
programme.desc: Después de que su pierna es aplastada por una roca, Gregg Hein queda varado en un alto pico de la Sierra con una fractura compuesta infectada. Sabiendo que no se denunciará su desaparición hasta pasados varios días, Gregg intenta arrastrarse por la montaña y rescatarse a sí mismo.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S03:E06 - Crushed by a Boulder Part 2

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E07 - Iraqi Sniper Attack
programme.desc: Durante su despliegue en la provincia de Anbar, el sargento mayor del Cuerpo de Marines Buck Doyle se pone en peligro para salvar a un compañero caído a manos de un francotirador iraquí y se convierte él mismo en objetivo.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S03:E07 - Iraqi Sniper Attack

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E08 - Lightning Strike
programme.desc: Una excursión de pesca de lubina sale terriblemente mal cuando un rayo cae en su barco, dejando a Christian Neal, de diecisiete años, quemado e inconsciente y a su padre Gabe volando al agua y paralizado. Se necesitará un milagro para salvarlos.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S03:E08 - Lightning Strike

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E09 - Mountain Lion Attack
programme.desc: La infante de marina Anne Hjelle practicaba ciclismo de montaña cuando fue arrancada de su bicicleta por un puma. Anne se defendió mientras el gran felino le destrozaba la cara con sus mandíbulas. Sobrevivir al ataque fue sólo el principio de la increíble lucha de Anne por sobrevivir.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S03:E09 - Mountain Lion Attack

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E13 - Desperate World
programme.desc: Horas desesperadas examina algunas de las peores catástrofes del mundo. Analiza la erupción del Eyjafjallajökull en Islandia, los terremotos de Nepal. epidemias como el ébola y el SARS, el incendio de la Zona de Nuevo Desarrollo de Binhai en China, el huracán Sandy en Nueva York, el tsunami del Océano Índico en el sudeste asiático, un destructivo sumidero en Bosnia, el desastre de la central nuclear de Fukushima, la catástrofe del gas de Bhopal, el accidente del Exxon Valdez en Alaska, y accidentes de tráfico y aéreos.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E01 - Lost!
programme.desc: Nick and Laura subject themselves to intense survival training with the Survival Training School of California deep in the mountains.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E02 - Sniper Science
programme.desc: Nick y Laura exploran la variedad de habilidades que utilizan los francotiradores militares: puntería, tiro a larga distancia, detección, acecho, camuflaje, infiltración, reconocimiento especial y adquisición de objetivos.

programme.title: Survival Science - - S01:E03 - Surviving a Bear Attack
programme.desc: Nick y Laura ponen a prueba la potencia y velocidad de los osos pardos utilizando herramientas de acróbatas de Hollywood para experimentar un ataque. Además: un intento de recrear el disparo de una flecha que salvó a un hombre del ataque de un oso.
programme.sub-title: Survival Science - - S01:E03 - Surviving a Bear Attack

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E04 - Surviving a Mountain Lion Attack
programme.desc: Laura y Nick desmenuzan los comportamientos, la fuerza, la vista y la velocidad de los pumas mediante experimentos y exploran técnicas para hacer frente a estos depredadores ápice.
programme.sub-title: Survival Science - S01:E04 - Surviving a Mountain Lion Attack

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E06 - Crushed by a Boulder Part 2
programme.desc: Después de que su pierna es aplastada por una roca, Gregg Hein queda varado en un alto pico de la Sierra con una fractura compuesta infectada. Sabiendo que no se denunciará su desaparición hasta pasados varios días, Gregg intenta arrastrarse por la montaña y rescatarse a sí mismo.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S03:E06 - Crushed by a Boulder Part 2

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E07 - Iraqi Sniper Attack
programme.desc: Durante su despliegue en la provincia de Anbar, el sargento mayor del Cuerpo de Marines Buck Doyle se pone en peligro para salvar a un compañero caído a manos de un francotirador iraquí y se convierte él mismo en objetivo.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S03:E07 - Iraqi Sniper Attack

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E08 - Lightning Strike
programme.desc: Una excursión de pesca de lubina sale terriblemente mal cuando un rayo cae en su barco, dejando a Christian Neal, de diecisiete años, quemado e inconsciente y a su padre Gabe volando al agua y paralizado. Se necesitará un milagro para salvarlos.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S03:E08 - Lightning Strike

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E09 - Mountain Lion Attack
programme.desc: La infante de marina Anne Hjelle practicaba ciclismo de montaña cuando fue arrancada de su bicicleta por un puma. Anne se defendió mientras el gran felino le destrozaba la cara con sus mandíbulas. Sobrevivir al ataque fue sólo el principio de la increíble lucha de Anne por sobrevivir.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S03:E09 - Mountain Lion Attack

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E02 - Operation Camper

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E01 - After the Fall

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E02 - A River's Grasp

programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S02:E02 - A River's Grasp

programme.desc: Tanalian Aviation lucha contra el clima invernal para transportar escaladores de hielo al glaciar Knik.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S02:E02 - Without a Trace
programme.desc: Los pilotos de Tanalian Aviation Joel Natwick y Josiah Freeman ayudan en la búsqueda y rescate de un excursionista experimentado en las profundidades del desierto invernal.
programme.sub-title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S02:E02 - Without a Trace

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E03 - Operation Yellowstone
programme.desc: 在第五區，守衛們乘坐噴射船沿著黃石河行駛，目睹著釣魚導遊，意外碰到了一起船隻事故。在那之後，他們前往第一區進行射擊練習。

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E04 - Operation Antelope Dummy
programme.desc: 隨著普朗霍恩羚羊的數量下降，第7區的守護者在賽季開始前設置了一個誘餌突襲，但主要問題似乎是在開幕日進入的事故。而同時，第4區的守護者布萊恩·戈利接到了關於可能的偷獵事件的電話。

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E03 - ATV Nightmare
programme.desc: Una acampada de padre e hijo se convierte en una lucha desesperada por sobrevivir cuando John Sloot queda aplastado bajo un quad. Ahora su hijo de 10 años, Cody, debe enfrentarse solo a la naturaleza para conseguir ayuda.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S02:E03 - ATV Nightmare

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E04 - Trapped in a Glacier
programme.desc: Mientras practica senderismo en solitario en las profundidades del Parque Nacional de los Glaciares, Ted Porter se precipita por una grieta glaciar. Con la espalda rota y a kilómetros de cualquier persona, debe luchar para sobrevivir.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S02:E04 - Trapped in a Glacier

programme.title: Gold Fever - S21:E04 - Virtual Gold
programme.desc: Tom y Kia nos dan una vuelta por el campamento minero de Cripple River, y Tom decide buscar lo que él llama "oro virtual"... ¿usando restos de cohetes?

programme.title: Gold Fever - S21:E05 - Prospectors
